verdict: PENDING MUTANTS; NOT ADOPTED. 1.083x <= 1.10 is measured with the local operand store doubled (LWB 19 = 524,288 words; the routed hfd_su / hfd_sfu masters are LWB 18). The limiter at LWB 18 is ring capacity: forwarded max A 64K + exp O 64K + bf16_p O 64K do not fit the 192K ring beside the 64K stream-0 region, so bf16_p's FRONT waits in S_WAITA.
physical: Adopting LWB 19 on the flat unit doubles the operand macro payload of hfd_su (and hfd_sfu if kept symmetric): it invalidates the routed hfd_su master and its operand-bank tiles and needs a re-route through tools/ref_tile (depth-matched local macro tiles on separate local roots, bank seams <= 500 um, M5 cap) plus a die-lead slot change. Under B2 the same capacity is available without new macros: a 65,536-element operand is partitioned 4 ways (SPEC F2), so each SU quarter holds 16,384-element operands in its own LWB 18 store. That needs the B2 quarter bench (8-lane slice port + section 4 ordered carry), which does not exist yet.
